title: Emergency Gardening & Food Growing
description: Ranks beginner, high-calorie, and nutrient-boosting crops and walks through starting a survival garden in the ground, raised beds, or containers. Covers composting, seed saving, season extension, chemical-free pest control, watering strategies, and a monthly planting calendar.
shortDescription: Beginner crops, raised beds, containers, composting, and seed saving
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
